highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.0.0 preview modernizes the bindings, graphics engine, and supported .NET platforms.
highlights_body: It introduces current .NET tooling, updated Skia and HarfBuzz dependencies, accelerated views, and a broad API cleanup. This preview contains breaking API changes; review the migration guidance before adopting it.

breaking.title: Previously obsolete APIs were removed
breaking.body: APIs that had been marked obsolete were removed from the managed surface. Update callers to their documented replacements and rebuild against the new API-diff report.

breaking.title: Platform view APIs were realigned
breaking.body: Several platform-specific view and graphics APIs changed as the supported target frameworks were modernized. Update platform project references and adjust code to the current view APIs.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Skia m116 and refreshes HarfBuzz, WebP, and JPEG support for the modernized release line.
Adds SKBlender, SKImage.ToRawShader, SKPicture recording APIs, and span-based overloads for color filters and rounded rectangles.

bullets.lead: Accelerated and web view support expanded
bullets.detail: Adds GL views for desktop platforms and accelerated WinUI views, while Blazor components can now respect display density.
Fixes Metal snapshots, Uno canvas pixel format and activation, MAUI view lifetime handling, and cloned SKPaint disposal.
Updates projects to .NET 8 and enables Metal rendering on Mac Catalyst with shared Metal API target frameworks.

contributor_summaries.jeromelaban: Uno canvas reliability and MAUI view lifecycle fixes
contributor_summaries.maxkatz6: Platform configuration trimming and shared Metal target framework work

contributor_summaries.jeremy-visionaid: Safe disposal for cloned SKPaint instances

preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.5.4: Preview 5 completed .NET 8 modernization, compatibility work, and native asset packaging.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.4.1: Preview 4 expanded graphics APIs and corrected platform rendering and lifetime behavior.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added desktop GL support, Blazor display-density support, and Metal rendering fixes.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animation and shader APIs alongside Mac Catalyst Metal support.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.1.8: Preview 1 established the SkiaSharp 3.0 API cleanup and modernized platform foundations.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz stack and modernizes its interop bindings alongside the SkiaSharp 3.0 platform transition.
